intro.heading: Overview
intro.body: Hoard CTI is built as a set of small, independent repositories that each own one slice of the pipeline. This page tracks the programme milestones; each splintered roadmap below tracks the delivery detail for its own repository.

callout.title: Automatically generated
callout.body: Milestones and progress on this site come straight from GitHub milestones, issues and the Hoard CTI project board, and refresh every hour.
